title: SeqMaestro: From nucleotide sequences to biological hypotheses through interpretable machine learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.14882v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Nucleotide sequence analysis is central to problems spanning regulatory genomics, evolutionary biology, and phenotype prediction. Classical bioinformatics methods extract interpretable sequence properties such as motifs and k-mer composition, but their flexibility is limited. In contrast, modern deep learning models can learn powerful predictive representations directly from raw sequences, yet their internal representations and decision mechanisms are difficult to inspect. translated_title: SeqMaestro：通过可解释机器学习从核苷酸序列到生物学假设
translated_abstract: 核苷酸序列分析是调控基因组学、进化生物学和表型预测等众多问题的核心。经典的生物信息学方法能够提取可解释的序列特征（如基序和k-mer组成），但其灵活性有限。相比之下，现代深度学习模型可以直接从原始序列中学习强大的预测性表示，但其内部表示和决策机制难以审视。可解释机器学习方法（如稀疏线性模型和决策树）能够提供人类可理解的预测关系表示，但并非设计用于直接处理核苷酸序列。在此，我们提出SeqMaestro，一个利用可解释模型从核苷酸序列中提出生物学假设的机器学习框架。我们的解决方案以一个双层接口为核心，该接口将核苷酸序列与可解释模型连接起来。
tldr: SeqMaestro是一个可解释机器学习框架，通过将核苷酸序列与稀疏线性模型、决策树等可解释模型相连接，弥补了经典生物信息学方法灵活性不足与深度学习模型黑箱化之间的鸿沟，能够直接从序列数据中生成可理解的生物学假设。
en_tdlr: SeqMaestro is an interpretable machine learning framework that bridges the gap between the limited flexibility of classical bioinformatics and the opacity of deep learning, enabling the generation of human-understandable biological hypotheses directly from nucleotide sequences.
